content.value_statement: Unclear names make code harder to review and maintain. This skill analyzes identifiers and suggests clearer names that match language and project conventions.
actual_capabilities: Reviews variable, function, class, file, database, and API names.
Flags vague, misleading, abbreviated, overly short, and overly long names.
Checks camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, boolean prefixes, and constant naming patterns.
Explains each naming suggestion with context and severity.
Produces a structured naming analysis report with prioritized rename suggestions.
Can outline a staged plan for approved rename work.
limitations: Recommendations depend on the code and context supplied to the assistant.
It may miss project-specific conventions that are not documented.
It does not guarantee that proposed renames compile without tool-assisted refactoring and tests.
It does not apply changes unless the user approves an edit workflow.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Feature Code
use_cases.description: Review new files before merge and replace vague names with clearer domain terms.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Create consistent naming feedback for pull requests across a team.

use_cases.title: Modernize Legacy Modules
use_cases.description: Identify confusing legacy identifiers and plan safe rename priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Review One File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a focused file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use naming-analyzer on the current file. List unclear names and suggest replacements with short reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Check Language Conventions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for a known language style.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use naming-analyzer for this Python module. Compare names with Python conventions and report only actionable issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review Pull Request Naming
prompt_templates.prompt: Use naming-analyzer on the changed files in this branch. Prioritize misleading names, boolean names, and inconsistent conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Large Rename Refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a broader refactor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use naming-analyzer on src/services and src/models. Group related renames, identify risk, and propose a staged refactoring plan.

output_examples.input: A payment module uses generic names such as data, temp, and process.
output_examples.output: The report flags vague names, suggests domain-specific alternatives, and explains why each replacement improves readability.

output_examples.input: A user service has a read-style name for a function that also updates login state.
output_examples.output: The report marks the name as misleading and recommends an action phrase that reflects both fetching and updating.

output_examples.input: A mixed JavaScript codebase uses inconsistent boolean prefixes and constant casing.
output_examples.output: The report groups convention issues, recommends one standard, and separates high-priority readability changes from style cleanup.

best_practices: Provide the target language, framework, and project naming rules before analysis.
Ask for prioritized recommendations when reviewing large modules.
Verify accepted renames with IDE refactoring tools and tests.
anti_patterns: Do not rename identifiers without understanding their domain meaning.
Do not mix several naming conventions in the same module.
Do not accept shorter names when they hide important behavior.

faq.question: Can this skill rename code automatically?
faq.answer: It can suggest names and outline a plan. Actual edits should use approved refactoring tools and tests.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Go, plus general naming patterns.

faq.question: Can it follow my team style guide?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the style guide or examples, and it can compare names against those rules.

faq.question: Does it detect misleading names?
faq.answer: Yes. It looks for names that imply one behavior while the code performs another behavior.

faq.question: Is it useful during code review?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize naming issues and provide replacement suggestions for review comments.

faq.question: Can it handle database and API names?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes tables, columns, endpoints, files, directories, and code identifiers.
